android.desc:
With a busy schedule full of appointments and tasks, it’s easy to let self-care slip through the cracks. Maintain U is here to help. This simple, effective app makes it easy to stay on top of essential self-care activities—whether it’s medical or dental appointments, shopping trips, or other routines that support your health and well-being.

Maintain U is your personal self-maintenance assistant, helping you effortlessly book and manage the care you need to feel your best.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Self-maintenance app, Maintain U

quotes.text:
As a former healthcare worker I launched the Maintain U app, a smartphone application designed to empower users with effective self-maintenance scheduling. While some apps focus on one particular area of maintenance, I designed the app so that it would cover a variety of areas such as personal care, mental health, medical activity, exercise, relaxation, spirituality, and entertainment.

The purpose of the app is to manage and coordinate the task of scheduling self-maintenance activities and keeping up with the appointments.For example, I once had a complex med schedule that was made simpified by scheduling my doses on the Maintain U app. The app allowed me to keep my med doses on schedule.

My inspiration for creating the Maintain U app stems from a deeply rooted belief that it is just as important to maintain one's self as it is to maintain one's house or vehicle to preserve them.  Go to the the following link to try the Maintain U app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.myapp.maintainu
